body.statement: For CauCA with known DAG, if every node has one perfect stochastic intervention satisfying the almost-everywhere interventional-discrepancy condition of Assumption 4.1, equality of the observational and interventional laws identifies the latent coordinates up to componentwise invertible transformations.

source.verbatim_statement: Suppose for each node i in [d], there is one perfect stochastic intervention that satisfies Asm. 4.1. Then CauCA in (G, F, P_G) is identifiable up to S_scaling.

attestation.note: Directly verified against the NeurIPS 2023 publisher PDF, Causal Component Analysis, page 5, Assumption 4.1 and Theorem 4.2(ii), accessed 2026-09-11.
